default_input_policy.description: Default policy for incoming traffic on the INPUT chain. Choose 'DROP' (secure) or 'ACCEPT' (permissive). Enum: ACCEPT, DROP.

default_output_policy.description: Default policy for outgoing traffic on the OUTPUT chain. 'ACCEPT' is typical for servers; 'DROP' increases security. Enum: ACCEPT, DROP.

default_forward_policy.description: Default policy for forwarded traffic (used in router/NAT setups). 'DROP' is recommended unless routing is required. Enum: ACCEPT, DROP.

icmp_allow.description: If true, allow incoming ICMP echo-request (ping) and echo-reply. Enable for diagnostics; disable for stricter security.

icmp_accept_rule.description: The firewall rule applied to ICMP traffic. 'ACCEPT' allows pings, 'DROP' blocks them.
